verdict.rationale: Luma is a hosted AI video and image generation platform. A product of this kind could publish its source or models under an open license, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack mentions open-source code, a public repository or an open license; the evidence covers only a credit-based API, SDKs and a browser workspace, none of which amount to readable source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
